description: Calculate net (take-home) pay from a gross US salary for 2026: federal income tax, Social Security to the annual wage base, Medicare including the additional Medicare surcharge, and state income tax for any of the 50 states or DC. State rules differ substantially and nine states levy no income tax. Free and read-only; tool calls are rate-limited per IP.

filingStatus.description: single, or mfj for married filing jointly. Defaults to single.

pretax401k.description: Optional annual pre-tax 401(k) contribution in USD

salary.description: Gross annual salary in USD, e.g. 120000

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. CA, NY, TX, DC

name: get_take_home_pay
title: US take-home pay
